subject: R shiny: Refresh browser while application is running

messages.author: a1e1cf6392d020fc
messages.subject: R shiny: Refresh browser while application is running
parts:
I had posted this question on stackoverflow, but I was not able to get any answers and was advised to come here for more help.

I have a shiny application/server which I force to run for 20 seconds and then I run the progress bar on the browser. However, if I was to refresh the browser, then the browser does not refresh until the application has finished running. Is there a way to have the application terminate when the browser is refreshed?

My application is the stackoverflow post. The application takes any file, then when the ActionButton is clicked, the application runs for 20 seconds. Meanwhile the progress bar will be visible at the top of the page.

Thanks for any help.
